citations.assessment: Megillah gives the transmitter as son of Rabbi Yannai the Elder and attributes the teaching to Rabbi Yannai Rabbah.

The matching Nedarim passage is 22a. It specifies the daughter’s son and names his interlocutor Rabbi Yannai the Elder. Ritva’s version names Rabbi Yannai Rabbah as the interlocutor, as does Heilprin.

notes.text: Heilprin specifies descent through a son, contrasted with descent through a daughter in the next clause. The cached Megillah reads simply son.
